findings.title: Recommendation output lacks required structured provenance and an as-of anchor
findings.what: The tool-error recommendation asserts a 20%+ failure rate and causal retry/waste implications but has only display evidence and no structured provenance. The stale-project recommendation similarly claims inactivity using "last 42d ago" without recording the evaluation date, so the historical signal cannot be reproduced later from the receipt alone and is not demoted to an explicit "as of <date>" statement.
findings.fix: Have these recommendation builders emit structured provenance identifying source artifacts, fields, observed values, and inference; add the detector evaluation date to historical detail/evidence as an explicit as-of value, then regenerate the snapshot.
findings.acceptance: The regenerated snapshot gives both recommendations structured provenance with source/field/value observations, and the stale-project output contains an explicit ISO-date "as of YYYY-MM-DD" anchor while preserving the reproducible 42-day calculation.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read the cited snapshot claims and the smallest directly related baseline rule. The underlying stale rule computes age from its supplied clock but emits only the relative day count, and neither cited recommendation carries structured provenance; the defect is current and reproducible at the audited baseline.
